integrity: All claimed infinite-dimensional conclusions follow from the written proof, not the finite verifier. Sources are cited with exact arXiv identifiers and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The explicit countable Hilbert family and a one-way injectivity criterion are proved; no universal classification, general converse, nonorthonormal basis classification or full automorphism/derivation theory is claimed. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains a literature risk.
title: Surjective evolution operators with nonunique orthonormal natural bases: complete orthogonal moduli
